name: Jiri Prochazka

official.source: data/derived/fighters.json (75 in height, 80 in reach, orthodox, born 1992-10-14); 92.07 kg (about 203 lb) at the UFC 327 official weigh-in on 2026-04-10, his last fight (KO loss to Carlos Ulberg).

photo_coverage: Good. 7 photos from 2022 to April 2026: a sharp 2026 frontal studio headshot, two full-body studio cutouts (2026 buzz cut, 2024 topknot), a free 2022 three-quarter (CC BY 3.0), a near-profile fight photo (2025), a sharp 2026 three-quarter from below, and a 2026 media-day photo. A second free 2022 still (File:JiriProchazkaBelt2022.png) and a CC0 2020 photo (File:Jiří "Denisa" Procházka 2020 07 Strahov Praha.jpg) exist on Commons but could not be downloaded because Commons was rate-limiting.

face.shape: Long, rectangular-oval face: tall forehead, moderate cheekbone width, long lower face. The full beard squares off and lengthens the jaw area.
face.jaw: Moderately wide with a long ramus; hidden by the beard in every recent photo. The 2022 shorter-beard still suggests a firm, fairly straight jawline.
face.chin: Long and moderately projecting under the beard; width medium.
face.cheekbones: Moderately prominent, set mid-high; cheeks lean and slightly flat below them.
face.brow_ridge: Moderate to strong; the brows sit close above the eyes and he often carries a slight frown with a vertical crease between the brows.
face.forehead: Tall and broad, fairly upright, with faint horizontal lines; looks taller with the head shaved.

eyes.shape: Almond-shaped with moderately heavy upper lids; outer corners level to slightly down.
eyes.colour: Light blue-grey (clearest in the 2026 headshot and walkout close-up).

eyebrows.shape: Fairly straight with a soft rise toward the outer third; inner ends sit low and close, often drawn together.
eyebrows.colour: Medium brown, a little darker than the beard's lighter areas

nose.width: Medium; narrow bridge widening to a moderately full tip
nose.hump: Very slight convexity at the upper bridge in the 2025 near-profile; essentially straight
nose.tip: Medium, slightly rounded, pointing straight forward to faintly down
nose.fight_damage: None obvious; centred and straight in the frontals.

mouth.upper_lip: Thin to medium, partly hidden by the moustache
mouth.lower_lip: Medium-full, pink, clearly visible under the moustache
mouth.resting_expression: Closed, slight downturn, intent; a wide toothy smile off duty (2022 interview).

ears.cauliflower_ear: Yes on the LEFT ear in April 2026: the upper ear is swollen and lumpy (walkout close-up). The right ear looked normal with only slight thickening in 2022.

face.notable_marks_scars: No large scars visible. Fight-night cuts and swelling (e.g. on the nose and around the eyes after fights) are temporary.

hair.style: Current look (2025-2026): very short buzz cut about 1 cm, shaved smooth to the scalp on fight night (UFC 320, October 2025). 2023-2024 look: undercut with shaved sides and back and the long top tied into a high topknot on the crown (2024 studio cutout). Before mid-2022 he wore long hair; he cut it off after winning the title in June 2022.
hair.colour: Medium brown (reads lighter on the buzz because the scalp shows through).
hair.hairline: Full front hairline, fairly straight across with mild recession at the temples.

facial_hair.detail: Full beard and moustache about 4-5 cm at the chin (2026 headshot and walkout), about 3 cm in 2022. Natural cheek line set fairly high, full under the jaw and onto the neck. The moustache covers the top of the upper lip.
facial_hair.colour: Medium brown with ginger-red and dark-blond tones, lighter at the chin edges and darker at the roots and moustache.
facial_hair.density: Dense and even across the chin, jaw and moustache.
facial_hair.shape: Rounded full beard, slightly longer at the chin, untrimmed edges.

skin.tone_hex_method: Mean of the 8 samples not marked excluded (9x9-pixel medians). Studio highlights, a near-clipped cheek, shadow sides, the overexposed media-day cheek and the red-cast walkout samples are left out.
skin.tone_note: Fair-to-light skin with a warm, ruddy-peach cast; the cheeks and nose flush redder than the forehead. The ESPN studio images are bright and run lighter; arena and TV light runs redder. tone_hex_recommended averages the cutout cheeks, the abdomen and the media-day cheek.
skin.freckles_marks: No obvious freckles. Moderate light-brown body hair over the chest, sternum, belly and legs (clear in both cutouts); light forearm hair.
skin.texture_pick_reason: Nearest swatch by colour distance (tied with middleage_asian_male at #e8ccb2); tint warmer and pinker toward #e59e7d.

body.build: Tall, long-limbed and lean. Reach (80 in) is 5 in more than his height, so the arms look noticeably long, with long forearms and big hands; long legs.
body.body_fat_notes: Visible abs and obliques in both studio cutouts (2024 and 2026), with a little softness at the lower belly; not bodybuilder-dense.
body.shoulders: Broad and rounded with full deltoids; trapezius moderately developed.
body.arms: Long, lean and sinewy rather than bulky; visible forearm veins.
body.waist: Narrow to moderate; a clear V-taper.
body.legs_calves: Long legs with lean, defined thighs and slim calves.
body.posture: Upright and loose; in studio poses he leans slightly forward with arms hanging away from the body. Listed orthodox, but his fighting style is famously unorthodox: very bladed, hands often low, switching stances and leaning back from range; at UFC 320 he threw long straight punches from a wide stance.
body.notable_physique_traits: Arm length relative to height; moderate body hair; no tattoos.

tattoos_note: None visible on the chest, abdomen, arms, legs or face in any photo (both full-body cutouts and the action photo). His back is not clearly shown.
accessories_seen: Dark beaded necklace (2022 interview); wristwatch (2026 media day).

kit.typical_shorts: Red Venum fight shorts: red with a dark-red wave pattern and a black UFC waistband (2026 cutout); red with a dark-red speckle pattern and white slashes, 'PROCHAZKA' down the leg (UFC 320, 2025; 2024 cutout). Gold gloves in the 2024 cutout (former-champion portrait).
kit.gloves: Black UFC gloves on fight night.

render_hints.skin_base: mh-skin-middleage_caucasian_male tinted toward #e59e7d with a light flush on cheeks and nose
render_hints.hair: buzz cut about 1 cm as a scalp tint #5b4031 (2026); optional 2023-2024 variant: shaved sides with a topknot
render_hints.beard: full beard about 4-5 cm, #7a4a38 with lighter ginger-blond tips

morphs_not_in_embed._note: assets/embed/mh-manifest.json has no ear targets. Ears are medium and moderately protruding, so no scale change; the left-ear cauliflower swelling (2026) needs a sculpt or normal map, not a slider.

notes: Confidence: high for skin range, hair history, beard, body and the absence of tattoos; medium for face proportions (sharp 2026 frontal and three-quarter, one near-profile from 2025); low-to-medium for exact morph values. Watch for: (1) The full brown beard with ginger-blond tones is his single biggest identifier; keep it 4-5 cm and rounded, with the lower lip showing. (2) Light blue-grey eyes under low, close, medium-brown brows, often in a slight frown. (3) Long, straight, high-bridged nose and a long face with a tall forehead. (4) Head: buzz cut about 1 cm now (shaved on fight night); use the topknot/undercut only for a 2023-2024 version. (5) Fair, warm, ruddy skin; avoid the overexposed studio pinks and the red arena cast. (6) Body: lean and long-limbed (reach 5 in over height), moderate light-brown body hair on chest, belly and legs, no tattoos. (7) Left-ear cauliflower in 2026. macro/ageOldM 0.138 follows avatar3d.js (34-25)/65; heightUpM 0.27 matches the other 190.5 cm sheets; proportionsUpM 0.65 reflects the long reach.
